cases.query: DDIM training inference iterations Nvidia 3080 latency
cases.minimum_evidence_requirement: Distinguish training denoising iterations from inference iterations, supply hardware-specific latency and units; do not infer an end-to-end control rate.

cases.query: How can the robot plan a future movement sequence while staying responsive to new observations?
cases.minimum_evidence_requirement: Describe observation-conditioned sequence prediction, partial execution and replanning; distinguish prediction and action horizons.
Identify temperature alpha in an entropy-augmented objective and its weighting role; distinguish physical or unrelated sampling temperature.

cases.query: How often was performance checked, and how were repeated benchmark runs aggregated?
cases.minimum_evidence_requirement: Give an explicit performance evaluation cadence with units and explain aggregation across repeated runs, preserving population and statistic. Multiple source protocols can answer the unspecified question.
Identify the non-randomized constant action timestep as a comparison condition; distinguish it from randomized timing and simulator integration.

cases.query: Which simulated properties stay unchanged during one rollout, and which disturbances are redrawn while the controller runs?
cases.minimum_evidence_requirement: Distinguish episode-constant sampled dynamics parameters from runtime redrawn perturbations with explicit temporal sampling conditions.

expected_policy: Original six queries and targets unchanged. Relevance criteria recorded before execution; acceptable alternative source protocols may pass only with inspected evidence.
